purpose: before/after comparison for the lookupRule precompute (issue #148)
method: interleaved A/B: both test binaries were built once with 'go test -c ./internal/engine', then executed alternately (baseline, candidate, ten pairs) so background-load drift affects both sides equally
notes: Same host as the go1.25.11 baseline packet. The toolchain moved from go1.25.11 to go1.26.7, so the baseline was re-measured at the merged benchmark commit instead of comparing against the go1.25.11 numbers.
The host is a desktop with background load. Sequential count=10 runs on this host showed session-to-session drift up to roughly 1.4x in ns/op, which motivated the interleaved method.
